issue: Missing values stored as the string "?" (object dtype in numeric columns)
rationale: Without this, date and score columns are strings and every numeric summary is wrong
verification: dtypes of date_registration, date_unregistration, score, date are numeric after load

issue: Exact duplicate rows and repeated (student, site, day) keys in the click log
action: Kept all rows; clicks are summed
rationale: Repeated keys are plausibly separate visits to the same page on one day, and the dataset documentation does not call them errors. Dropping them would under-count engagement.
verification: Sensitivity check planned in notebook 03: compare features with and without exact duplicates

issue: Metadata says 32,953 students in one place and 32,593 in the class table
action: Used the observed row count (32,593) as the truth
rationale: Row count is verifiable from the data

issue: Students who unregistered before day 28 are not a valid prediction target
action: Excluded from the modelling population by the date rule, whatever their label (rows kept in raw data)
rationale: They were no longer enrolled at prediction time. Keeping them would leak the label.
verification: population = 27,553; 8 excluded rows are labelled Fail rather than Withdrawn (see S4b)

issue: 9 students have an unregistration date but final_result is not Withdrawn (documentation says unregistered means Withdrawn)
action: Rule applied to the date, not the label; remaining cases (left after the cutoff) kept
rationale: The date is the direct evidence of leaving; the label may reflect a different recording rule

issue: 93 Withdrawn students have no unregistration date, so their exit time is unknown
action: Kept in the population; NOT flagged in the master table (a flag derived from the outcome would leak it)
rationale: Cannot verify they were enrolled at day 28. Small share; listed as a limitation and checked in a sensitivity run later.
verification: share of population reported in notebook 03

issue: Raw click log has 10.6M rows and no student-level features
action: Filtered to date < 28; aggregated to student-presentation: total, active days, distinct sites, first click day, clicks per period, clicks per activity type (top 6 + other)
rationale: Only pre-cutoff behaviour may be a feature
verification: max click date used = 27 (< 28); weekly and type columns sum to clicks_total

issue: Submission and score columns include post-cutoff submissions and banked scores from earlier attempts
action: Kept only date_submitted < 28 and is_banked == 0; built n_assess_submitted, n_due_submitted, mean_score_early; merged module-level n_assess_due from the schedule
rationale: Later submissions leak the outcome; banked scores are not this presentation's behaviour

issue: imd_band uses two label styles ("10-20" and "10-20%")
action: Removed the % sign so all labels share one style
rationale: Otherwise the same band is treated as different categories

action: Kept as missing and added imd_missing flag; no imputation at this stage
rationale: Imputation must be fitted on training data only. Missingness may itself be informative (check in notebook 03).

action: Added ordinal codes imd_order, edu_level, age_order and kept original text columns
rationale: Preserves ordinal meaning for models and correlation without discarding labels

issue: date_registration missing for a few students
action: Left missing and added reg_date_missing flag
rationale: Too few to impute meaningfully; the flag keeps them visible

issue: Students with no click rows or no early submissions after the left joins
action: Count features set to 0 and no_vle_activity flag added; first_click_day, mean_score_early and submit_rate_early left missing
rationale: Absence of log rows means zero recorded activity. A score or first-click day does not exist, so it stays missing.

issue: date_unregistration is only recorded for students who withdraw (post-outcome information)
